_about: Which WoW Forever auction house belongs to which ruleset and faction. Blizzard's API lists every house under every ruleset, so this is mapped by hand: python tools/ah_prices.py match compares your own GoldScout scans with each house. Only add a house once a scan has matched it.

111.how: 2026-11-10: GoldScout scan on CAMWOWUS1Realm7PvE (Alliance) matched 88% of lowest prices; no other house above 21%

113.how: 2026-11-09: GoldScout scan on CAMWOWUS2Realm2PvP (Horde) matched 67% of lowest prices; no other house above 25%

114.how: 2026-11-10: GoldScout scan on CAMWOWUS1Realm7PvE (Horde) matched 94% of lowest prices; no other house above 22%

116.how: 2026-11-10: GoldScout scan at the Blackwater (goblin) auction house on CAMWOWUS2Realm2PvP matched 86% of lowest prices (1,653 items in common); confirms houses come in Alliance/Horde/Blackwater sets (110/113/116)

119.how: 2026-11-10: GoldScout scan on CAMWOWUS1Realm10RP (Alliance) matched 91% of lowest prices; no other house above 17%

120.how: 2026-11-10: GoldScout scan on CAMWOWUS1Realm10RP (Horde) matched 92% of lowest prices; no other house above 18%

123.how: 2026-11-10: GoldScout scan on CAMWOWUS1Realm9RPPvP (Alliance) matched 89% of lowest prices; no other house above 17%

124.how: 2026-11-10: inferred by elimination, not yet confirmed by a scan (RP-PvP Horde characters can't be made: faction balance). Houses come in Alliance/Horde/Blackwater sets (110/113/116 PvP, 111/114/117 Normal, 119/120/121 RP, 123/124/125 RP-PvP); scans confirmed 113, 114, 111, 119, 120 and 123, and 124 is the only remaining Horde house with listings (115 is empty).
